say:1:1130510001:1.text: Transporting and selling goods. More and more people are settling in Alkali, and the prices of everything under the sun have gone up tenfold.
say:1:1130510001:1.source_cn: 运货卖货，咸水镇聚集的人越来越多，你眼睛能瞧见的一切东...
say:1:1130510001:1.male: Transporting and selling goods. More and more people are settling in Alkali, and the prices of everything under the sun have gone up tenfold.
say:1:1130510001:1.female: Transporting and selling goods. More and more people are settling in Alkali, and the prices of everything under the sun have gone up tenfold.

say:2:1130510002:1.text: I sold my first batch of merchandise, and this was to be the second. But now my hired hands have gone missing...
say:2:1130510002:1.source_cn: 第一批货物已经卖光了，这是第二批，结果两个伙计忽然消失了。
say:2:1130510002:1.male: I sold my first batch of merchandise, and this was to be the second. But now my hired hands have gone missing...
say:2:1130510002:1.female: I sold my first batch of merchandise, and this was to be the second. But now my hired hands have gone missing...

say:3:1130510003:1.text: Even if their plan was to just run off, a farewell would've at least sufficed.
say:3:1130510003:1.source_cn: 就算走也打声招呼啊……真叫人担心。
say:3:1130510003:1.male: Even if their plan was to just run off, a farewell would've at least sufficed.
say:3:1130510003:1.female: Even if their plan was to just run off, a farewell would've at least sufficed.

say:4:1130510004:1.text: I'll keep an eye out anyway. Maybe they just got lost in a sandstorm.
say:4:1130510004:1.source_cn: 我还是周围再找找吧，也许他们只是在沙暴中迷路了。
say:4:1130510004:1.male: I'll keep an eye out anyway. Maybe they just got lost in a sandstorm.
say:4:1130510004:1.female: I'll keep an eye out anyway. Maybe they just got lost in a sandstorm.
